title: Only an unreceived special order's cost can still be re-entered
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Use staging (preferred), or the Tiered Pricing QA site too once the release is deployed there; production is not needed.
  • Note the attached Today picture shows this screen before the release; the steps check that it still works the same way.
  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, left on Default for work orders and Part Sales.
  • Have a new inventory part for this test at your location, in category A, cost $10.00.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer B, made after customer B's tier was set, with one labor line (line 1), with that inventory part, a received special-order part and an unreceived special-order part on line 1, all category A.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click the inventory part's description.
  3. Click Cancel.
  4. Click the received special-order part's description.
  5. Click Cancel.
  6. Click the unreceived special-order part's description.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens on its Lines tab.

Step 2:

  • Cost is grayed.
  • The dialog opens.

Step 3:

  • The dialog closes.

Step 4:

  • Cost is grayed.
  • The dialog opens.

Step 5:

  • The dialog closes.

Step 6:

  • Cost can be typed in.
